LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO, AND MYRTIS COCKREL'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR, IN THE ALTERNATIVE, SUMMARY ADJUDICATION. MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED. ALTERNATE MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS DENIED. TRIABLE ISSUES REGARDING WHETHER: 1) THE CITY WAS PLAINTIFF'S EMPLOYER FOR PURPOSES OF FEHA; 2) PLAINTIFF WAS CONSTRUCTIVELY DISCHARGED; 3) PLAINTIFF WAS CONSTRUCTIVELY DISCHARGED BECAUSE OF HIS RACE, GENDER, SEXUAL PREFERENCE OR DISABILITY; 4) PLAINTIFF WAS SUBJECTED TO HARASSMENT WITHIN THE MEANING OF FEHA; 5) PLAINTIFF WAS HARASSED BECAUSE OF HIS RACE, GENDER, SEXUAL PREFERENCE OR DISABILITY; 6) PLAINTIFF ENGAGED IN PROTECTED ACTIVITY UNDER FEHA; AND 7) PLAINTIFF WAS CONSTRUCTIVELY DISCHARGED BECAUSE HE ENGAGED IN PROTECTED ACTIVITY. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: HAROLD E. KAHN, REPORTER: LAVENA WARD, CSR# 7077
